title: Miso Ginger Dressing
description: A quick Japanese-inspired dressing combining miso paste, rice vinegar, soy sauce and fresh ginger.
ingredients: 1 tsp peeled and finely grated fresh root ginger
steps: Mix all ingredients in a small bowl.
notes: Pairs with the Japanese-style Bounty Bowl (p.138). Great over crisp lettuce and ribboned carrot.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
